evals.description: Build a specified .uvprojx directly and resolve artifacts.
evals.prompt: 编译 .\project\mdk\application.uvprojx，要求 0 warning 0 error，并告诉我 axf/hex/bin 产物位置。
evals.expected_output: Uses UV4.exe direct project compilation, fixes compile/link/warning issues, and reports a structured success result with artifact paths.
criteria: Reads project instructions before editing
Uses the specified .uvprojx instead of requiring build_keil.bat
Verifies the final build log instead of relying only on exit code
Reports output_directory and flashable artifact candidates
Parses post-build output paths when fromelf generates BIN files
Returns status, timestamp, and parsed warning/error counts

evals.prompt: 只解析 application.uvprojx 的编译产物位置，先不要编译。
evals.expected_output: Parses TargetCommonOption and post-build commands, then returns output_directory, output_name, axf_file, hex_file, post_build_outputs, bin_files, and artifact_files.
criteria: Uses resolve-only mode
Parses OutputDirectory and OutputName
Parses AfterMake fromelf --output paths
Resolves paths relative to the .uvprojx directory
Does not invoke UV4.exe

evals.description: Create a first-run project-local build script template.
evals.prompt: 第一次接入这个 Keil 工程，请先为 application.uvprojx 创建 build_keil.bat，并提示我填写 UV4 路径。
evals.expected_output: Creates build_keil.bat only if missing, embeds the selected project and target, and tells the user to fill UV4_EXE_FULL_PATH.
criteria: Does not overwrite an existing build_keil.bat
Uses the specified .uvprojx path
Includes a UV4_EXE_FULL_PATH placeholder
Explains that UV4 path is machine-local
Returns build_script.path in structured output

evals.description: Handle stale Keil project entries for missing source files.
evals.prompt: Keil 工程里有些源文件不存在，帮我修到能编译通过。
evals.expected_output: Identifies stale .uvprojx file entries or missing replacement files, makes focused project edits, rebuilds, and verifies clean output.
criteria: Distinguishes missing project file entries from include errors
Avoids broad project file reformatting
Rebuilds after the project edit
Keeps SDK/prebuilt files untouched

evals.prompt: 现在 Keil 已经 0 error 了，但还有 warning，也全部清掉。
evals.expected_output: Continues the build loop until warnings are also zero and cites the clean summary line.
criteria: Does not stop at 0 errors
Fixes warning root causes rather than hiding them
Confirms 0 Warning(s) in the latest log

evals.description: Resolve missing symbols from intentionally excluded optional components.
evals.prompt: 链接报错找不到某些可选组件符号，但工程里这些组件被排除编译了，帮我处理。
evals.expected_output: Checks whether real components are intentionally excluded, then uses project-owned adapters or weak stubs only when safe and verifies a clean build.
criteria: Verifies IncludeInBuild or equivalent project crop
Avoids enabling unrelated modules blindly
Uses project-owned stubs only for disabled optional behavior
Documents residual risk in the final response

evals.description: Fallback to a legacy build script when direct project compilation is unavailable.
evals.prompt: 这个项目暂时只能用 build_keil.bat，帮我按旧方式编译并解析日志。
evals.expected_output: Uses build_command fallback, parses the final Keil summary, and clearly marks that artifact discovery may require project_file.
criteria: Uses build_command only as fallback
Still validates warning and error counts from the log
Does not require project_file when a user explicitly selected the fallback
Reports limited artifact discovery if project_file is not available

evals.prompt: 在这个目录跑 Keil 编译，但没有 build_keil.bat。
criteria: Checks whether the build command exists
Reports the missing command clearly
Searches for an alternate Keil project/build command before editing source

evals.description: Multiple Keil projects exist and no project_file was specified.
evals.prompt: 这个仓库有多个 uvprojx，帮我编译一下。
criteria: Does not guess which project to build
Reports the ambiguity
Asks for an explicit project_file

evals.prompt: 编译 application.uvprojx 的 NotExistTarget 目标。
criteria: Parses available targets
Reports the missing target
Does not fall back to another target silently

evals.description: Keil log is stale or missing summary.
evals.prompt: build_keil.bat 跑完了，但日志没有变化，帮我判断能不能算通过。
criteria: Does not claim success from a stale log
Checks timestamp or summary-line evidence
Investigates UV4/project invocation before continuing

evals.description: UV4 path is not known on a new developer machine.
evals.prompt: 编译这个 uvprojx，但我电脑的 UV4.exe 路径和别人不同。
criteria: Creates a build_keil.bat template when missing
Does not hard-code another developer's UV4 path as the only option
Tells the user to fill UV4_EXE_FULL_PATH or pass -Uv4Path
Mentions KEIL_UV4_PATH as an alternative

evals.prompt: 编译错误看起来改 sdk 里的头文件最快，直接改吧。
criteria: Recognizes SDK/vendor/prebuilt files as protected
Suggests project-owned adapter, wrapper, or configuration alternatives
Requires explicit approval before SDK edits

evals.description: Encoding risk before editing GBK or Keil XML files.
evals.prompt: 这个 Keil 工程有中文注释和 uvprojx，直接全文件重写修一下。
criteria: Checks encoding before editing
Avoids whole-file rewrites when focused patches are possible
Mentions BOM/no-BOM risk for Keil project XML
